{{Quote|Jedi Solo to see you.''"<br />"''Tell her that I expected her six seconds ago. Then let her in.|The secretary and Jagged Fel|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
A '''secretary''' worked for [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] in his [[Offices of the Imperial Head of State|offices]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="Conviction" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], Fel's [[Marriage/Legends|fiancée]], arrived at the offices for a visit. Fel's [[Secretary/Legends|secretary]] informed Fel that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Solo was there to see him, so Fel told the secretary to let her into his offices and to stress to her that he was expecting her earlier prior to granting her entry.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jagged Fel's secretary appeared in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', the seventh book in the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series. The novel was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2011]].<ref name="Conviction" />
